info.name: Campions API - Auth, Branches, Employees, Members and CRM
info.description: Login first; accessToken is saved automatically. Includes authentication, branch, employee and all nine Member Management endpoints. Set ID/date/profile variables deliberately and send modifying requests individually. Optional auth tests intentionally exercise errors. CRM folders cover all 19 Lead/follow-up routes. Send writes individually; conversion creates a Member, not a subscription/payment. Subscription reads, freezes, medical extensions, employee grants and Owner holidays are included; paid activation/renewal intentionally have no HTTP route.

request.description: Use any username here. On success the script automatically saves accessToken for Current user.
Send Login first. The saved collection accessToken is sent automatically; no copying/pasting.

exec: if (!savedAuthToken) { throw new Error("Send 1. Login successfully first."); }

item.name: 3. Branch management
item.description: Manual requests, not a safe whole-collection runner workflow. Requires Branches.View/Manage plus branch scope. Creating a branch requires Branches.AccessAll. Set cityId from an existing active City; no City creation endpoint exists. PUT is a complete settings update; set isActive false to deactivate. No DELETE endpoint exists.

request.description: Branches.View. Scoped users see only their current branch; explicitly global users see all branches.
Branches.View plus scope on branchId.
Branches.Manage and Branches.AccessAll required. Set cityId to an existing active city. Success saves the created ID into collection branchId.
Branches.Manage plus scope. Set branchId/cityId and all intended settings. Change isActive to false for soft deactivation; historical data is preserved.

item.name: 4. Employee branch assignments and transfers
item.description: Management requests modify real development data: send individually to the intended employee. employeeId must reference an existing Employee; this feature provides no Employee CRUD. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the configured gym calendar timezone, today or later. Transfers require a date after the current assignment start, both branch scopes, and an active target. Set targetBranchId deliberately; it is never auto-selected.

request.description: Employees.View plus scope on employee current branch, or global access. Unassigned employee can produce 204 for an authorized global user.
Employees.View plus scope on employee current branch, or global access.
Employees.Manage plus target scope. Set branchId and assignmentStartDate. Requires active employee/branch and no overlapping history. Use transfer for a currently assigned employee.

Employees.Transfer and scope on both branches. Cross-branch transfer requires explicit global access under the current conservative policy. Set employeeId, targetBranchId and transferEffectiveDate. Existing business transaction branches remain unchanged.
Employees.View. Add optional search, branchId, status and employmentType query parameters. totalCount is before paging.
Employees.View plus branch scope. totalCount gives assigned count; add status=Active to count active employees only.
Employees.View plus scope; no payroll or Identity secrets.
Employees.Manage plus scope. Remove initialBranchId only for globally authorized unassigned creation. No login account is created. Returned ID replaces employeeId.
Employees.Manage plus scope. Full profile body; retain current values. No branch/account/status fields.
Employees.Manage plus scope. Active, Suspended or Resigned (existing ended-employment name). Resigned sets termination date; Active clears it.

item.name: 15. Sales and Payments
item.description: Select ONE workflow at a time: these are real financial mutations, not a bulk test suite. Amounts illustrate a 1200 plan: quote the actual price and configure source accounts. PurchaseMode FullPayment=0 Reservation=1 Installment=2 StandaloneSingleSession=3; Activation Now=0 FirstCheckIn=1 SpecificDate=2; General=0 MemberOnly=1; Cash=0 InstaPay=1. Early renewals are immediate. Keep each UUID for exact retries; CLEAR its environment value before a different intentional operation. First entry uses the Check-In folder. Owner explicitly selects branch; staff use their authenticated branch. Standalone needs an eligible one-session plan, preserves debt/borrow allowance and is commission/target ineligible.

request.description: Read-only list of active Cash and InstaPay accounts for the selected branch. Requires Payments.View and branch access. Set branchId to the employee's operational branch; do not confuse the branch ID with a returned financial account ID. The response contains id, branchId, name, method and isActive, but no balances. This request does not configure a drawer, open a Shift or move money. Reception token is used here; the next request uses the Owner token for drawer setup.

item.name: Owner: active branch accounts for drawer setup

request.description: Use the Owner token and explicitly select the Sales employee's operational branch with branchId; an Owner normally has no default operational branch. Requires Payments.View and access to the selected branch. Find an active account with method Cash and copy its id into cashAccountId before the one-time Vault drawer setup. An empty list means no active Cash/InstaPay account exists for this branch. This GET is read-only and does not create a financial account, drawer, Shift or ledger movement.

item.name: Quick Cancel — Reception chooses refund within 24 hours
16. Employee shifts, shared vault, expenses and advances
item.description: Manual own employee shifts may overlap at one shared branch drawer. Set a real physical count for opening/closing. Counts are observations, not employee balances. Setup/category/withdrawal additionally require explicit global capability; payouts require own open shift. No routine external Cash-In or approval queues. Use requests individually; never run all financial examples blindly. Clear an operation variable only for a new intentional operation.

request.description: One-time Owner/global setup of the selected branch's shared Cash drawer, not an employee Shift. Requires Vault.Manage and Branches.AccessAll. Include branchId because an Owner normally has no current operational branch. financialAccountId must identify an active Cash account of that branch. countedCash is the real physical opening count; a positive count on a virgin zero-opening account records an audited initial-position ledger movement, not Sales revenue. Reuse the same OperationId and body only for a retry of this exact setup.

The logged-in active employee manually opens only their own Shift at their assigned operational branch; requires Shifts.Manage and a configured shared branch drawer. openingCash is the real count of the shared drawer at opening, not employee-owned money. No open BusinessDay is required when today's BusinessDate applies. Reuse the same OperationId and body only for a retry of this exact opening.
